title: Company conspiracy and alliance-building intensify
detail: East India Company officials coordinated with dissatisfied court elites and financiers to isolate Nawab Siraj ud-Daulah before open confrontation.

title: Battle of Plassey
detail: Near Palashi, Company forces under Robert Clive engaged the Nawab's army. Key commanders withheld full participation, decisively weakening the Nawab's position.

title: Siraj ud-Daulah is overthrown
detail: After the defeat, Siraj ud-Daulah lost political control and was captured and killed; Mir Jafar was installed as Nawab with Company backing.

title: Company influence over Bengal administration expands
detail: Revenue demands, commercial privileges, and political appointments increasingly reflected Company priorities rather than autonomous nawabi governance.

title: Colonial consolidation begins in Bengal
detail: Plassey opened the path to deeper Company rule, culminating in far-reaching control over Bengal's economy, institutions, and sovereignty.
